card.name: Dosing interval units after every
card.fires_on: The time unit (mostly "weeks") right after "every" plus a number in dosing schedules, mainly cancer infusion regimens. Also "daily" after "once" and the space after "every" before a number.

modes.label: Weeks after every N
modes.description: The word weeks closing an interval such as every 3 weeks in an oncology dose line.

modes.label: Daily or spacing after every
modes.description: The word daily after once, or the gap after every before a number of weeks.

card.writes: It seems to steer the output away from "regular" and "each" style continuations after the interval is complete.
card.plain: It marks the end of a dosing interval like "every 3 weeks" in a cancer drug schedule.
